title: Problem Overview
content: Erdős Problem #1083: Distinct Distances in Higher Dimensions. Status: OPEN

title: F
content: f_d(n): the minimum number of distinct distances determined by n points in ℝ^d.

title: Erdos Bounds
content: **Erdős (1946)**: n^{1/d} ≪ f_d(n) ≪ n^{2/d}.  The upper bound is achieved by a grid configuration. The lower bound uses a pigeonhole argument. ∃ c₁ c₂ : ℝ, c₁ > 0 ∧ c₂ > 0 ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, n ≥ 2 → c₁ * (n : ℝ) ^ (1 / (d : ℝ)) ≤ (f d n : ℝ) ∧ (f d n : ℝ) ≤ c₂ * (n : ℝ) ^ (2 / (d : ℝ))

title: Solymosi Vu
content: **Solymosi-Vu**: For d ≥ 4, f_d(n) ≫ n^{2/d - c/d²} for some constant c > 0.  This improves the lower bound from n^{1/d} toward the conjectured n^{2/d}. ∃ c : ℝ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, n ≥ 2 → (f d n : ℝ) ≥ (n : ℝ) ^ (2 / (d : ℝ) - c / (d : ℝ)^2)

title: Erdos Conjecture
content: **Erdős's Conjecture (OPEN)**: f_d(n) = n^{2/d - o(1)}.  The conjectured lower bound matches the grid upper bound up to subpolynomial factors. ∀ ε : ℝ, ε > 0 → ∃ c : ℝ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, n ≥ 2 → (f d n : ℝ) ≥ c * (n : ℝ) ^ (2 / (d : ℝ) - ε)

title: Erdos 1083
content: Known: n^{1/d} ≪ f_d(n) ≪ n^{2/d}. Conjecture: f_d(n) = n^{2/d - o(1)}. ∃ c₁ c₂ : ℝ, c₁ > 0 ∧ c₂ > 0 ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, n ≥ 2 → c₁ * (n : ℝ) ^ (1 / (d : ℝ)) ≤ (f d n : ℝ) ∧ (f d n : ℝ) ≤ c₂ * (n : ℝ) ^ (2 / (d : ℝ)) := erdos_bounds d hd
